Vibration modes. With absorbing layers or low-reflecting boundaries the frequencies are complex (signed Q = Re f / (2 Im f)).

f_search.description: Search around [Hz]. 0 finds the lowest modes

oneOf.description: Vibration modes of a body of revolution; the mesh is the (r, z) half plane with x = r, and the displacement goes as exp(-j m theta). With absorbing layers the frequencies are complex: Im f > 0 and Q = Re f / (2 Im f); the scalar 'layer fraction N' tells a resonator mode from a layer mode. Every mode also carries 'f re N (Hz)' and 'f im N (Hz)' as numbers and its energy shares outside the layers: 'radial share N', 'axial share N', 'azimuthal share N' and 'share in <region> N'. At m = 0 the torsional modes (azimuthal displacement only, azimuthal share 1) are solved together with the radial and axial ones. The modes returned are the converged eigenpairs nearest f_search: their number can be smaller or larger than n_modes.

azimuthal_order.description: Azimuthal order. the displacement goes as exp(-j m theta); m > 0 runs along +y

f_search.description: Search around [Hz]. 0 finds the lowest modes

oneOf.description: Elastic waveguide modes on the 2D (x, z) cross-section; the displacement has three components (ux, uz, uy) and goes as exp(-j q y) with longitudinal wavevector q. With absorbing layers or low-reflecting boundaries the frequencies are complex: Im f > 0 and Q = Re f / (2 Im f); the scalar 'layer fraction N' tells a guided mode from a layer mode. Every mode outputs the fields '|u|', 'Re ux', 'Re uz', 'Re uy', '|uy|' and the scalars 'f re N (Hz)', 'f im N (Hz)', 'QN' (with loss), 'layer fraction N', 'lateral share N', 'vertical share N', 'longitudinal share N' and 'share in <region> N'.

f_search.description: Search around [Hz]. 0 finds the lowest modes

wavevector.description: Longitudinal wavevector [rad/m]. wavevector q along +y; the displacement goes as exp(-j q y)
